name: Common Lisp
summary: ANSI-standardized Lisp dialect unifying MacLisp descendants, with CLOS multiple dispatch and a metaobject protocol, a restartable condition system, packages, and powerful non-hygienic macros.

level_notes.1: The ANSI standard (X3.226-1994, reaffirmed as INCITS 226) is paywalled; the CLHS (LispWorks HTML rendering derived from the final draft) and dpANS3 PDF are the free authoritative texts and are tagged standard-draft. The MOP (AMOP ch. 5-6) is a de-facto standard; CLtL2 is the pre-standard reference. No standard successor process exists; CDRs are community extensions.
level_notes.0: Multiple conforming implementations: SBCL (linked in depth), Clozure CL, ECL, CLISP, ABCL (JVM), Clasp (LLVM); ansi-test is the shared conformance suite.
